newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCorp to buy TPC for $288 mln.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCorp to buy TPC for $288 mln.

text.p: PacifiCorp said Wednesday that its subsidiary, PacifiCorp Holdings Inc, has definitively agreed to acquire TPC Corp of Houston, Texas, for $13.41 a share, or a total price of about $288 million.
PacifiCorp said it would begin a cash tender offer for all outstanding TPC common shares March 18.
The merger is subject to conditions of federal antitrust law. If approved, it would be slightly dilutive to earnings in 1997 and accretive thereafter, PacifiCorp said.
TCP is a natural gas gathering, processing, storage and marketing company that had revenues of $617 million of 1996.

"The acquisition recognizes the great progress TPC has made in expanding our gathering and processing business, our gas marketing operations, and our gas storage business. The combination of TPC and PacifiCorp makes us a formidable competitor in eastern energy markets," PacifiCorp said in a release.
